verdict.rationale: Only one documented line notes that high-end machine types like H100 require approval to use, implying a request-based process, but there is no broader documented quota system (e.g., per-account instance limits, GPU count caps) or a defined support/ticket process for raising limits. missing for 10: documented quota/limit tables per account, explicit process for requesting limit increases, evidence of SLA or support workflow for quota changes.
